findings.detail: WI-8's AC#8 scan greps non-test production source for the six locale-code literals (incl 'cs-CZ') with a 3-file whitelist. But spec section 'Non-goal' MANDATES 'cs-CZ' in ~30 non-test production files (money.ts Intl.NumberFormat('cs-CZ'), TrackingPage, HistoryRow, PlatformScreen, AuditPage, DriverDrilldown, smsCostDisplay, GeoUsagePanel, StatusHeadline, csvExport, OrderDrawer, SearchPage, ~15 more). The gate as specified can never go green — AC#8 unsatisfiable. Fix: only flag the FIVE non-default codes {en-US,ru-RU,uk-UA,fil-PH,de-DE} in the production scan (cs-CZ formatting literals are spec-mandated), and/or route formatting through a named constant module and whitelist it; keep the registry-iteration checks for selector/detection/parity.

WI-1 seeds ru-RU/uk-UA/fil-PH/de-DE as key-complete Czech copies, so parity is GREEN before and after WI-3..6 — no observable RED, WIs not atomically verifiable, pipeline could complete with Czech placeholders shipping. Fix: each language WI asserts a curated SENTINEL set of non-brand full-sentence keys (2-3 dispatcher + 2-3 customer) differs from cs-CZ for that locale — RED against the seed, GREEN after real translation.
Verified safe: common.language does not yet exist; WI-1 adds it to cs-CZ first and propagates to all six seeds before WI-3..7 run. No action.

Verified exhaustive: only extra importers are locales.parity.test.ts, auditEventLabel.test.ts, eventTimeline.test.ts, PlatformScreen.test.tsx changeLanguage('cs') — all in WI-1 files_touched. No language==='cs' runtime branches; no test asserts i18n.language==='cs'.
Verified: detection wiring (main.tsx) + playwright.config.ts locale pin are in the same atomic WI-2; no ordering exists where detection lands unpinned.
Verified no cross-feature imports (shared component rollout); aria-label t('common.language'), theme.touchTargets.min=48px confirmed, axe test present.

notes: Reviewer had no Write tool; persisted by conductor. Verified-passing: DAG acyclic, AC->WI covers all 8, lane citations complete, rename ripple exhaustive, host files + touch-target token exist.
